title: Chocolate Oat Protein Bites
description: No-bake cocoa oat bites with whey and peanut butter for a portable training-day snack.
ingredients: A little water and a pinch of salt
steps: Mix all ingredients into a firm, slightly sticky dough.
Roll into four equal bites with damp hands.
Chill for at least 30 minutes before eating.

source.label: Inspired by Good Food protein balls

notes: Batch these for the fridge — a protein-forward snack beats a sugar-only one for the 3pm slump.
